### Relationships Between Modifications

- The new test cases in `CloneTestIT.java` are designed to validate the correctness of the cloning process, including the new path generation logic. By expanding the integration tests, the patch not only fixes the bug but also enhances future testing coverage to prevent similar issues from occurring again.
